page.layout: One page of text, all in one block. Running text at the top, then two centred closing lines in italic, then a centred doxology. Page number at the head, ornamented, between flourishes.

main_text.p: ne tributum , tùm excellentiæ titulo honoratum iri : quas machinationes Cæsareus legatus advertens , respondit : se nil mirari , si vel ab alio vel gallico legato celsissimi titulo honoraretur, sed injuriam fore non levem, si id non fieret , deinde se sponte nosse, quid loci , titulive hospiti tribuendum , & quam personam sustineret , proinde, uti penes legatum Gallicum esset , visitationem vel perficere, vel omittere ita & sibi omnino certum esse , nihil omittere aut facere , quod in ejusmodi solennitatibus , Majestati Imp. tantillum detrahere possit.

p.i: UNI & TRIUNO sit Gloria , in sempiterna Secula.

page.notes: The ornamented page number is read as (15). No running head, catchword or signature is printed. The italic closing lines are set as paragraphs, not headings. Some letters in the running text are blurred (for example the "s" forms in "nosse" and "tribuendum"), but they read clearly enough to copy.
